sheets.prompt: Use case: identity-preserve, production character sprite animation for DoggyKnight. Re-draw the indicated golden retriever from the reference as ONE perfectly regular square 3 columns by 3 rows transparent animation atlas, nine separate full-body silhouettes. Same endearing adult golden retriever throughout, dark nose, soft floppy ears, golden tail, three-quarter biped side view facing SCREEN RIGHT every time. Elegant, finely inked, hand-painted gouache Arthurian children's-book realism. Honey fur, cream muzzle, warm umber contour, soft light from upper left, satin metal and restrained colors. Clear action silhouette at game scale. Exactly nine figures, centered on their individual equal cells; completely transparent gutters wider than the brush edge, all weapons, tails, ears, foot and hem inside the cell. Each standing foot on the same baseline in its cell. Same head size, limb length, boots and weapon ornament in every frame. No panel borders, scenery, labels, letters, UI, drop shadows, floor, effects or bits of loose background. Do not fill the whole cell with the face. Feet are weight-bearing paws, sleeves end in expressive dog paws, never human fingers. Grid positions read left to right: row one: relaxed ready, running contact near foot forward, passing position legs under hip; row two: opposite running contact far foot forward, running lift legs gathered with cape trailing, preparing the class move; row three: precise release, follow-through, recovery to ready. Really pose the limbs and angle torso/changing ears in the motion, keep character identifiable. Leave generous margins for runtime anchoring. The knight reference is the identity and costume guide. Indigo short cape, brushed silver breastplate and ochre brass shoulder fittings, pale simple steel long sword with a small gold crossguard in right paw, dark leather boots. In row two right it draws the sword high behind the head without hiding the face; row three left it lunges and the blade reaches horizontally right; center it carries past the strike low to the right; right it settles back to guard. Blade is visibly one object throughout.
